user_prompt: I need to set up automated safety checks for our engineering change orders and material updates before they go to production. We've been manually validating everything against our compliance requirements, but it's slowing down our releases. Can you help me automate this validation process?

result_preview.title: Safety Compliance Automation Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates safety validation across engineering changes, materials, and product items.
result_preview.description: Monitors and processes engineering changes, materials, and product items to enforce safety compliance requirements and automate BOM validation workflows. Coordinates supplier qualification assessments and initiates compliance remediation actions when safety risks or regulatory gaps are detected. Automates incident prevention through continuous validation of product configurations against safety standards.

result_preview.title: Product Safety Compliance Change Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages product safety changes and compliance requirements across manufacturing items.
result_preview.description: Provides access to engineering change notifications and product item safety compliance data for manufacturing environments. Exposes safety-related modifications to product specifications and enables retrieval of compliance requirements tied to engineering changes. Manages the integration of product safety assessments with engineering change workflows to ensure regulatory adherence throughout the product lifecycle.
